page.content:
1941 Roosevelt–Churchill statement of war aims.

How Atlantic Charter connects

  • Character: Winston Churchill — Churchill and Roosevelt issued the Atlantic Charter in 1941.
  • Character: Franklin D. Roosevelt — Roosevelt and Churchill issued the Atlantic Charter in 1941.
  • Faction: United Nations — The Charter's language fed the later United Nations.

What is Atlantic Charter?

The Atlantic Charter set self-determination, free trade, and a postwar security system as Allied language — a document the later UN claimed as ancestry.

Key threads lead to Winston Churchill, Franklin D. Roosevelt and United Nations.
